title: Colimit transport through a strict localization model
statement: For any abelian category A and scalar telescope cocone c of K in its derived category, suppose m is a strict complex localization model for c. If a functor F sends every strictly bounded-below complex telescope, computed by the indicated good truncation, to a colimit cocone, then F sends the lifted cocone c to a colimit cocone. Definitions and notation: [lem-weil-pbc-integral-localization-complex-model].

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), referring to Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.8.2; scalar localization telescope

proof.text: Whisker the representative isomorphism in the model to identify the scalar sequence diagrams. The model comparison isomorphism and its leg equations identify the resulting cocones. Transport the assumed colimit through these two isomorphisms.

proof_origin.note: B2: explicit scalar telescope construction and categorical compatibility. This auxiliary declaration is proved in the delivery, not a new assumption.

theorem localizationCocone_isColimit_of_model
    {A : Type v} [Category.{w} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory A]
    [HasColimitsOfShape (ULift.{x} ℕ) A]
    (K : DerivedCategory A) (c : Cocone (integralLocalizationSequence ℓ K))
    (m : IntegralLocalizationComplexModel.{v, w, x} ℓ K c)
    {B : Type y} [Category.{z} B] (F : DerivedCategory A ⥤ B)
    (hcont : ∀ (C : CochainComplex A ℤ) (a : ℤ), C.IsStrictlyGE a →
      Nonempty (IsColimit ((DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F).mapCocone
        (condensedContinuityCocone
          (integralLocalizationLiftedSequence.{max v w, w, x} ℓ C) a)))) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (F.mapCocone (c.whisker
      (ULift.orderIso : ULift.{x} ℕ ≃o ℕ).equivalence.functor)))
